title: Volume & Audio applet: Show output device information for each application
line: The Audio Volume applet's Applications tab now shows which device each app is playing to or recording from.
explanation: In the Applications tab, each stream only showed the app name; the device it was routed to appeared in brackets only while hovering the name (since Plasma 5.22), so you had to hover or open every stream's menu to see where it plays. Now the device name is always shown, dimmed and right-aligned next to the stream's menu button, when there is more than one device to choose from. Long app and device names share the row and elide.

commits.message:
applet: always show the device of each application stream

The device an application plays to or records from was only shown when
hovering its name, so seeing where each stream goes meant checking them
one by one. Show the device name dimmed next to the stream's menu button.

BUG: 495050
